binding_restriction.statement: For the tested common-grid workflow, quantitative measurements must be derived after rasterization on a target grid.
binding_restriction.status: A named instrumental workflow restriction, not a certified limit on competent expert methods or frontier intelligence.
binding_restriction.removability_reason: For explicit affine geometric maps, source zeroth/first moments and the absolute determinant determine the requested measures without target raster sampling.
binding_restriction.prior_art: Known affine algebra, conventional physical-space image analysis and label feature extraction; no new algorithmic novelty claimed.

replacement.representation: Source-native label moments plus an explicit geometric-pushforward contract.
replacement.center_convention: Index i is the voxel center; source support extent is i + [-0.5,0.5).
replacement.implementation_note: The frozen CLI recomputes native moments per invocation. The competent baseline caches native summaries across maps; persistent instrument caching was not constructed.

executable_realization.source_binding: Own one bounded NPY byte snapshot, hash that exact snapshot, validate the header/payload and contract, then measure those bytes.
executable_realization.scope_checks: Validate units, dimensions, axes, exact contract fields, label interpretation, map semantics, numerical conditioning and source hash.
executable_realization.mission_outputs: ACCEPT with measurements, or reasoned HOLD/REJECT; no substituted scientific purpose.
